name: @ars-infinita-notion/system-skills
description: The System (Player Edition) skills, built for the OpenAI Codex CLI and the Antigravity CLI (agy). Ships prebuilt — install with `npx @ars-infinita-notion/system-skills install-codex`. Claude Code users should install the native plugin from the marketplace instead.
author: Ars Infinita Contributors

scripts.check: node test/checks.mjs && node test/public-feed-contract.mjs && node test/package-file-boundary.test.mjs && node ../../tools/generate_catalog.mjs --check && node test/home-check.mjs && node test/discovery.mjs && node test/mobile-degradation.mjs && node --test test/visualization-adapter.mjs && node --test test/use-case-inventory.mjs && node --test test/source-install-build.test.mjs && node --test test/live-smoke-policy.test.mjs && node --test test/smoke-default.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && node test/smoke.mjs
scripts.install-unified: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const cp=require('node:child_process'); const run=(file,args=[])=>{const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[file,...args],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(r.error) throw r.error; if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1)}; if(fs.existsSync('builder.mjs')) run('builder.mjs'); run('install-unified.mjs',process.argv.slice(1));" --
scripts.install-codex: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const cp=require('node:child_process'); const run=(file,args=[])=>{const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[file,...args],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(r.error) throw r.error; if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1)}; if(fs.existsSync('builder.mjs')) run('builder.mjs'); run('install-codex.mjs',process.argv.slice(1));" --
scripts.install-agy: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const cp=require('node:child_process'); const run=(file,args=[])=>{const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[file,...args],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(r.error) throw r.error; if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1)}; if(fs.existsSync('builder.mjs')) run('builder.mjs'); run('install-agy.mjs',process.argv.slice(1));" --
scripts.prepublishOnly: node builder.mjs && npm run check && python3 ../../tools/leak_check.py && node ../../tools/gate_audit.mjs
